title: My Hero Academia Creator Confirms New Horror Manga
content: Creator Kohei Horikoshi has plenty to celebrate following the final chapter release of My Hero Academia . While the manga artist hasn’t hinted at Izuku Midoriya and the heroes of UA Academy ever making a comeback, this isn’t stopping Horikoshi from creating new manga stories.
author: ComicBook

title: My Hero Academia 10th Anniversary Reveals New Top 10 Heroes Visual
content: A special My Hero Academia 10th anniversary popup shop will open across Japan beginning on August 28, 2026, featuring new merchandise based on a visual adapted from an illustration by series creator Kohei Horikoshi.
author: Anime Corner

title: Sara Returns in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 5 Preview
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 5 preview images and synopsis ahead of its August 2 premiere. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .
author: Anime Corner

title: Reincarnated in a Mafia Dating Sim Anime Confirms TV Format
content: TO Books announced on Thursday the television format for the anime adaptation of Tōko Amekawa 's Reincarnated in a Mafia Dating Sim ( Akutō Ikka no Manamusume, Tensei-saki mo Otome Game no Gokudō Reijō Deshita. Saijōkyū Rank no Akuyaku-sama, Sono Dekiai wa Fuyō Desu! ) light novel series.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action S&X: Confession of Therapist Series' Trailer Reveals More Cast, August 20 Debut
content: Netflix unveiled a new trailer and key art for the live-action series of Kisei Tada 's S and X: Confession of Therapist ( S to X ~Therapist Shimotori Ichito no Kokuhaku) manga on Wednesday. The trailer revealed more cast and the August 20 premiere date for the series.
author: ANN

title: Gachiakuta Anime Streams 'First Look' Video for 2nd Season
content: The official website for the television anime of Kei Urana 's Gachiakuta manga unveiled a new "first look" promotional video for the anime's second season on Wednesday. The site also unveiled the flyer art (seen below) for the second season that was distributed at Anime Expo and Taiwan's Comic Exhibition earlier this…
author: ANN

title: Gachiakuta Season 2 First Look Teaser Featuring New Footage Revealed
content: Gachiakuta Season 2 revealed the First Look PV (promotional video) teaser trailer, giving fans an early preview of the anime’s next chapter. The promotional video features several new scenes from the upcoming season, including the first footage of new and returning characters. Check it out below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Märchen Crown Manga Enters Final Battle
content: This year's 34th issue of Shueisha 's Young Jump magazine revealed on July 23 that Aka Akasaka , Aoi Kujira , and Ajichika 's Märchen Crown manga is entering its final battle. The manga will take a one-week break and will return in the combined 36th and 37th issue of the magazine on August 6.
author: ANN

title: Last Game, Vampire Knight Manga Get New Chapters in August
content: The September issue of Hakusensha 's LaLa magazine revealed on July 24 that both Shinobu Amano 's Last Game manga and Matsuri Hino 's Vampire Knight manga will get new one-shot chapters in the magazine's next issue on August 4.
author: ANN

title: Kujira Anan's 'And Yet, You Are So Sweet ' Manga Ends
content: Kujira Anan 's And Yet, You Are So Sweet ( Na no ni, Chigira-kun ga Amasugiru ) manga ended with the fourth and final part of the manga's 60th and final chapter on July 22. Anan announced on their blog on May 17 that the manga would end in its 60th chapter.
author: ANN
